info.name: Bizuno ERP
info.summary: Launcher for the Bizuno ERP / accounting system inside NextCloud.
info.description:
Embed your Bizuno installation inside NextCloud. Adds a "Bizuno" entry to NextCloud's top navigation that opens your Bizuno system in a sandboxed iframe so users have a single launching point for daily work.
**Prerequisites:** a running Bizuno installation (the official Docker image at `ghcr.io/phreesoft/bizuno` is the simplest path). After enabling this app, go to Settings → Administration → Bizuno ERP and set the externally-reachable URL of your Bizuno server.
Bizuno is open-source ERP for small business: full double-entry accounting, CRM, inventory, sales, purchasing, payroll, shipping, and custom reporting. Visit [bizuno.com](https://bizuno.com) for more.
**Note:** This launcher does *not* include Bizuno itself — Bizuno is a separate web service that NextCloud frames. Single sign-on between NextCloud and Bizuno is on the roadmap; users currently authenticate to each separately.
info.author: PhreeSoft, Inc.
